overview: Evan Kormos describes policy, workflow graphs, agent loops, evaluation and exception routes as a path toward less supervision.
whyItMatters: An aggregate pass rate cannot license every tool action. Permission needs a versioned workflow, consequence tier and recoverable stop path.
ghostMeshTakeaway: Grant autonomy only for the evaluated action tier and policy version; retain independent effect readback, exception handling and operator interruption.

normalization.overview: Evan Kormos describes policy, workflow graphs, agent loops, evaluation and exception routes as a path toward less supervision.
normalization.whyItMatters: An aggregate pass rate cannot license every tool action. Permission needs a versioned workflow, consequence tier and recoverable stop path.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Grant autonomy only for the evaluated action tier and policy version; retain independent effect readback, exception handling and operator interruption.
normalization.falsification: Broaden autonomy only if a versioned, held-out and failure-injected trial shows lower operator work without more unauthorized or duplicate effects at the target severity.
